item.title: Sarla Maheshwari Dies: Veteran Doordarshan Anchor Passes Away
item.description: Sarla Maheshwari: Sarla Maheshwari, a renowned Doordarshan news anchor and a respected figure in Indian television, passed away on February 12, 2026, at the age of 71. She had carved a special place in the hearts of viewers with her calm personality, simple delivery, and clear and precise pronunciation of Hindi. Her contribution to the history of Indian television news will always be remembered. Also read: Ishika Shahi Honoured as ‘Most Promising Digital Creator’ at 6th Continental International

item.title: Anand Ramanand Sagar Chopra Passes Away, Sagar Arts Pays Tribute
item.description: It is with deep sorrow and profound grief, Sagar family announces the sad demise of their beloved father, Shri Anand Ramanand Sagar Chopra, who passed away peacefully today, 13th February 2026. item.description: By Shantiswarup Tripathi On November 1, 1996, history was created when the world-famous “King of Pop,” the late Michael Jackson, visited India—specifically Mumbai.
